segments.text:
V. 10.
Neither ſcrip—That is, a Wallet, or Bag to hold Proviſions: Nor yet a ſtaff—We read, Mark vi. 8. Take nothing, ſave a ſtaff only. He that had one might take it; they that had none, might not provide any. For the workman is worthy of his maintenance—The Word includes all that is mentioned in the 9th and 10th Verſes; all that they were forbidden to provide for themſelves, ſo far as it was needful for them.
